flagship.title: A little room by Falls Lake
flagship.standfirst: An easy pine-wood loop at Rolling View, close enough for a modest outing after the holiday.
flagship.why_this_week: Give the weekend a little breathing room without making it a long expedition. At Rolling View, the TRACK loop—also called Neuse Bend—passes through mixed pine woods along Falls Lake. Follow the short marked loop, let Rupert stop for a few leashed sniffs, and leave time for a packed snack in the picnic area. The official sources put the same loop at roughly six-tenths to three-quarters of a mile. This plan stays inside the day-use area; it does not extend onto the Mountains-to-Sea Trail, the marina or closed Holly Point. The dated forecast is sunny in the low 60s both days. Keep the outing in daylight; the Sunday-night shower chance is after this short walk’s window.

route.surface: Mixed-pine natural path along the lake; roots and wet leaves possible. Official trail table lists 0.75 mile; visitor guide calls the same loop 0.6 mile.

access.name: Rolling View TRACK / Neuse Bend trailhead, signed day-use picnic parking
access.parking: Enter Rolling View at 4201 Baptist Road and follow signs to the day-use picnic parking for TRACK / Neuse Bend. The partner trail map shows the start beside the picnic parking area, beside the lake. This is inside Rolling View, not the separate MST lot before the gate, private marina or Holly Point. November hours 8 a.m.–6 p.m.

dog.leash: Attended leash no longer than six feet. No pets on swim beaches or inside buildings.
dog.water: Carry drinking water and a bowl. Keep Rupert out of the reservoir; no swimming or paddling.
dog.shade: Mixed pine forest with open lake-edge sections.
watch_for: Marked trail junctions; stay on TRACK loop

photo.alt: Engraved print of Rupert resting on pine needles, mustard collar beneath a sparse pine branch.

pivot.if: Thunder, heavy rain, unsafe footing, high water, strong wind or official closure
pivot.note: Postpone and recheck the official status and forecast. No exposed outdoor storm alternative.

conditions.trail_note: Wet leaves can hide roots even during sunny weather. Stay on the marked TRACK loop, turn back for unsafe footing and keep Rupert out of the reservoir and off swim beaches.

practical.best_window: Late morning or early afternoon Saturday or Sunday, after checking current park status and NWS. Allow 30–60 minutes plus any picnic pause and return before dusk. The dated shower chance is Sunday night after 7 p.m.; do not plan an evening extension.
practical.fees: No vehicle entrance fee in November under the published seasonal schedule; reservations and private-marina services are separate.
